rationale: Paris shooting raises allied security concerns; West Bank attack adds Middle East tension; Jordan church shooting kills seven; Ebola case in Nigeria raises health concerns.

top_events.title: Anti-terror police investigate as one person killed in shooting near Paris
top_events.label: Shooting near Paris kills one, terror probe
top_events.summary: Gun attack in Trappes near Paris kills one; French PM calls it very serious. Raises security concerns for key NATO ally with minimal direct US impact.

top_events.title: Seven shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, state media say
top_events.label: Seven killed in Jordan church shooting
top_events.summary: Gunmen kill seven at church funeral in southern Jordan; ten injured. Adds to Middle East tensions in region where US has strategic interests.

top_events.title: Two Israeli soldiers killed in attack by suspected Palestinian gunmen in West Bank
top_events.label: Two Israeli soldiers killed in West Bank
top_events.summary: Palestinian gunmen kill two Israeli soldiers near Hebron days before election. Adds to Middle East tensions in region of US strategic interest.

short_summary: Oregon teacher survives shooting by playing dead

most_significant_event.label: Oregon teacher survives shooting by playing dead
most_significant_event.summary: Teacher describes surviving school shooting by pretending to be dead while badly injured. New domestic violence incident.
most_significant_event.title: Teacher in Oregon shooting said she pretended to be dead to survive
